entities.summary: Volcacius Sedigitus was a Roman literary critic who flourished around 100 b.c., noted for his ranking of those he considered the best Latin comics. He is believed to have been born in Rome, Italy, and died in 100 b.c. Sedigitus's work was influential in the development of Latin literature, and his rankings have been preserved in the works of later writers. The exact details of Sedigitus's life are not well-documented, but his significance in the history of Roman literature is undeniable. Sedigitus's ranking of Latin comedians has been studied by scholars for centuries, providing valuable insights into the cultural and artistic trends of ancient Rome.
